headline: One more run? Trade and reset? How the Lightning should handle the Kucherov situation
take: The Athletic asks whether Tampa Bay should make one more run or trade Nikita Kucherov and reset, arguing that letting him walk could effectively close the Lightning's window. Meanwhile, Daily Faceoff points out that he has 11 points in the six games since word got out that he won't re-sign. A player who has asked out is supposed to be a distraction. Kucherov is playing like a reminder of what Tampa would be giving up: 26 points in 18 games, after 130 last season. The team around him is 12-4-2 with 55% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), so this isn't a seller looking for an exit. Our one caution on the hot run: his on-ice results are running about 6.4 goals ahead of the chances, so some of the recent points are bounces. The talent isn't. That's what makes the decision hard: the Lightning look like a contender, with their best player headed for the door.
